pulse.text: **Quiet overnight** — no new models or ranking shifts since the last sweep. The freshest move is political: in a June 19 Axios interview Trump said he no longer sees **Anthropic as a national-security threat** ("not now, but a week ago, maybe"), praising Amodei after their G7 lunch and saying he doesn't want to shut the company down — a thaw that brightens the odds **Fable 5 and Mythos 5** get their June 12 export freeze lifted, though the ban is still formally in place. Standings are unchanged: **Claude Opus 4.8** holds the frontier (AA-Index **56** on the v4.1 scale, just ahead of GPT-5.5 at 55), and Polymarket still prices **Anthropic at ~96%** to own the best model at end of June (Google 3.4%, OpenAI 1.1%). The imminent release is **OpenAI's GPT-5.6**, which markets put at **83%** for a June 22–28 ship (97% by July 31), though the by-June-30 line slipped to ~78% from ~86%. Watch the next few days on two clocks: a possible Fable 5 reinstatement and GPT-5.6 actually landing.
